Where to Stay in Buriram?
12 Hotels We Actually Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites!
heroSub: 12 hand-picked Buriram hotels across every budget — from Amari's football-themed rooms beside Chang Arena down to a hostel by the train station from ฿320/night. Covering the main areas: around Chang Arena and the Chang Circuit, the city centre, and Nang Rong near Phanom Rung. From roughly ฿320–1,800/night.
heroStats: 🏟️ 3 key areas (Chang Arena·City Centre·Nang Rong–Phanom Rung)
introH2: 🏟️ Why does choosing the right area in Buriram matter so much?
introHtml: In Buriram, where you stay really does shape the trip, because the main draws sit in different directions. Around Chang Arena and the Chang Circuit is what football fans coming for Buriram United and motorsport fans coming for MotoGP look for first — these stays are a walk or a short drive from the stadium, so you skip the parking scramble on match day, but they're a fair way from the city's restaurants. Buriram city centre (the Jira Road–Robinson district) is the hub for malls, markets, food and the train station, ideal if you want to explore the city, eat your way around, or use Buriram as a base for Phanom Rung. And Nang Rong district, about 50 km from the city, sits much closer to the Phanom Rung and Mueang Tam Khmer temples — best if those ruins are your main goal. Many people book in the city expecting an easy walk to the stadium or quick drive to Phanom Rung, then burn hours driving back and forth. This guide rounds up 12 Buriram hotels we've already reviewed across every tier — with real guest-review scores, a 3-site price comparison and direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Buriram has no metro; you get around by car, and the province is spread out enough that your choice of area sets up the whole trip. Many stays around Chang Arena and the Chang Circuit (Isan/Samet sub-districts) are walkable to the stadium on match day, but dining around the hotels is thin, so come with a car or have Grab ready. City-centre stays are far easier, with Robinson mall, Saraka-Krao market and restaurants within walking distance, and the train station close by. Almost everything in Nang Rong district needs a private or rental car, as it's a separate district — it's about a 30-minute drive from Nang Rong to Phanom Rung. The areas in this guide: Around Chang Arena — walk to the stadium, football and motorsport · City Centre — malls, markets, food, the train station · Nang Rong — base for the Phanom Rung and Mueang Tam temples.

entries.name: Amari Buriram United
entries.badge: 🏆 Top score · next to the stadium
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Isan · on the Chang Arena grounds · 2-min walk
entries.storyHtml: Amari Buriram United takes the top score in this guide at 9.7 and ranks #1 in Buriram on TripAdvisor — it's Thailand's only Buriram United–themed hotel, sitting right on the Chang Arena grounds, under a 2-minute walk from the lobby to the stadium gate and next to the Chang Circuit. Real guest reviews praise the spacious 41 sqm rooms (all with balconies), a breakfast buffet many call the best in Buriram, and Amari-standard service. The trade-off: it's about 10 minutes' drive from the city centre, so you'll need a car to head out for food or nightlife. Best for football fans, motorsport visitors and families.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a room with a balcony facing the fountain and stadium — it's the signature view here. On home-match or MotoGP weekends the 60 rooms sell out fast and rates jump, so book months ahead and confirm your reservation.
pros: Top score 9.7 · #1 in Buriram on TripAdvisor
On the Chang Arena grounds, 2-min walk; next to the Chang Circuit
Thailand's only Buriram United theme · spacious rooms with balconies
Most-praised breakfast buffet · Amari-standard service
cons: About 10 minutes' drive from the city centre; a car helps for food and outings
Rates jump and rooms fill fast during big events — confirm bookings early

entries.name: The Crystal Hotel Buriram
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.4 · 176 reviews · formerly X2 Vibe Buriram
entries.badge: 💎 City-centre boutique · walk to the mall
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Buriram–Nang Rong Rd · city centre · 550 m to Robinson
entries.addr: 405 Moo 10, Buriram–Nang Rong Rd, Isan, Buriram
entries.storyHtml: The Crystal Hotel Buriram (formerly X2 Vibe / Cross Vibe) is the best-value city-centre boutique in town, scoring 9.4 from 176 reviews. Unlike the many stadium-area hotels, it sits on Buriram–Nang Rong Road, a 550-metre walk from Robinson mall. Real guest reviews praise the roomy, clean rooms, the saltwater pool with a separate kids' pool, and a made-to-order egg breakfast where the omelette gets frequent mentions. The catch: it's about 8 km from Chang Arena, so if you're mainly here for match day, a stadium-area hotel is handier. Best for exploring the city, mall trips, or using Buriram as a base for Phanom Rung.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling with kids? Pick a Pool Access room where you step straight into the saltwater pool. Get to breakfast early (06:30–10:30) and order the much-praised omelette. On Chang Arena race days, allow extra travel time.
pros: City-centre location, 550-metre walk to Robinson mall
Roomy, clean, modern rooms · saltwater pool with kids' pool
Made-to-order eggs, praised omelette · EV charger on site
Value that's genuinely hard to match in Buriram city
cons: About 8 km from Chang Arena / the circuit — not ideal if match-watching is your focus
Rates climb fast during big events; book ahead

entries.name: Modena by Fraser Buriram
entries.badge: 💬 Most reviews · walk to the stadium
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Samet · next to Chang Arena · 5-min walk
entries.storyHtml: Modena by Fraser Buriram is the most-reviewed hotel in this guide — 583 reviews — and the easiest walk to Chang Arena, scoring 9.2. Real guest reviews praise the roomy, clean rooms (with a JBL speaker), the two pools (outdoor and indoor), a 24-hour gym, and the Bistro@M breakfast with more choice than expected. Friendly staff come up again and again on the plus side. The stadium-side location does mean it's a fair way from the city and night markets, so without a car you'll lean on Grab. Best for football and motorsport visitors and families who want a pool.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Once you know a Buriram United home-match or motorsport date, book immediately — rooms fill fast and rates climb. Staying several nights? Make the most of the two pools and 24-hour gym. Keep a car or Grab handy for trips into town.
pros: Most reviews among the hotels (583) · 5-min walk to Chang Arena
Roomy, clean rooms with JBL speaker · 2 pools, 24-hour gym
Bistro@M breakfast with good choice · friendly staff
Free, generous parking · part of Frasers Hospitality
cons: A fair way from the city centre and night markets; lean on Grab without a car
Rates climb and rooms fill fast around stadium events

entries.name: Green@Buriram
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.6 · 59 reviews (top score on the value side)
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bypass Rd · Buriram city · ~3–4 km to Chang Arena
entries.storyHtml: Green@Buriram is a small garden hotel scoring a surprising 9.6 for a value stay, from 59 reviews — higher than several bigger city hotels. Rather than a row of rooms on a busy road, it's around 20 rooms set around a quiet green garden. Real guest reviews repeatedly call it "spotless" — bedrooms and bathrooms alike — and praise the à la carte cooked-to-order breakfast at Cafe@Green, served in the garden, plus an attentive owner. It is small, though: no pool, no lift, few rooms, and not walkable to Chang Arena (about 3–4 km). Best for drivers who value cleanliness and quiet over walking distance to the stadium.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Don't miss the à la carte breakfast cooked fresh in the garden — the nicest part of the day here. Some nights carry music from nearby venues, so if you're a light sleeper ask for a room deeper in the garden. With few rooms, book ahead on match weekends.
pros: 9.6 stands out · the cleanliness guests praise most
Small, quiet garden hotel — not a roadside block
À la carte cooked-to-order breakfast in the garden · strong Wi-Fi
Free parking · attentive owner and staff
cons: Small hotel: no pool, no lift, few rooms
Not walkable to Chang Arena — about 3–4 km by car

entries.name: TREX Buriram Boutique Hotel
tags: 🛏️ Big rooms 29–45 sqm, above the price
entries.storyHtml: TREX Buriram Boutique Hotel is a quiet garden boutique that football and motorsport visitors love for its big, clean rooms, scoring 9.2 from 41 reviews — with cleanliness and service both at 9.5. It sits in Samet, about 5 km from Chang Arena and the Chang Circuit. Real guest reviews praise rooms that feel larger than the price (from 29 sqm up to a 45 sqm junior suite), spotless and quiet, plus a garden pool, 24-hour gym and homemade, home-style food. The quiet does come at a cost — it's away from the shops, so you'll need a car, and the breakfast menu is limited. Best for couples or small families wanting a big, quiet room for a few thousand baht.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Driving yourself is easiest — there's free, generous parking; without a car, plan rides into town. Try the homemade food on site, but keep a city restaurant in mind for longer stays, since the menu isn't large.
pros: Big rooms 29–45 sqm above the price; very clean (9.5)
Quiet garden setting, good for unwinding after a match
Garden pool, 24-hour gym, free parking
Homemade home-style food, warm service
cons: Away from city shops and restaurants — a car helps
Limited breakfast menu; better suited to shorter stays

entries.name: Sky View Hotel Buriram
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.0 · 32 reviews · walk to Chang Arena
entries.badge: ⚽ Walk to the stadium · easy on the wallet
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Samet · ~300 m from Chang Arena · walkable
entries.storyHtml: Sky View Hotel Buriram (officially Sky View Resort Buriram) is the budget pick that genuinely lets you walk to Chang Arena — just about 300 metres from the stadium, scoring 9.0 from 32 reviews. For football fans who'd rather not deal with match-day parking, walking back to the hotel after the final whistle is an edge that's rare at this price. Real guest reviews praise the big 28–32 sqm rooms, good value, a saltwater pool that's larger than expected, and free parking. It's an older property, though — some rooms and facilities show their age, Wi-Fi is patchy in places, and dining around the hotel is thin. Best for budget-minded football fans who prioritise location and value.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Being walkable to the stadium, rooms here sell out fast on big-match days — lock in a free-cancellation rate early. Cool off in the saltwater pool after walking back from the match. Driving yourself is easiest, as there aren't many restaurants nearby.
pros: ~300 m walk to Chang Arena — a standout for match-watching
Big 28–32 sqm rooms, comfortable, good value
Saltwater pool larger than expected · free parking
From about ฿900/night, great for short football trips
cons: Older property; some rooms and facilities show their age, Wi-Fi patchy
Few restaurants or markets nearby — a car helps

entries.name: Phanomrungpuri Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nang Rong district · ~30 km to Phanom Rung
entries.addr: 212 Nang Rong–Lam Plai Mat Rd, Nang Rong, Buriram
entries.storyHtml: Phanomrungpuri Hotel is a Khmer-style boutique that ranks #1 in Nang Rong on TripAdvisor and makes the most sensible Phanom Rung base, scoring 8.8 from 252 reviews. It sits about 30 km from the Phanom Rung and Mueang Tam temples — a half-hour drive — cutting the long haul from the city. Real guest reviews praise the spacious Khmer–Isan rooms (27–50 sqm), leafy grounds and friendly, English-speaking staff. Reviewers do note thin walls (you'll hear next door), a small pool, and the 50 km distance from the city and Chang Arena. Best for visitors set on the temples and history.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Set off early for the ~30-minute drive to catch the sun through the Phanom Rung gateway before the heat and crowds. With thin walls, ask for a corner or upper-floor room and pack earplugs. In-room sockets are limited, so bring a power strip.
pros: #1 in Nang Rong · base for Phanom Rung–Mueang Tam ~30 km
Spacious Khmer–Isan rooms 27–50 sqm, nicely styled
Leafy, quiet grounds with pool, Barai restaurant, Thai massage
Friendly, English-speaking staff · easy on the budget
cons: Thin walls — you'll hear next door · small pool
Separate district, about 50 km from the city and Chang Arena; best with a car

entries.name: SNOW HOUSE Buriram
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Jiranakhon · in town · ~10-min drive to Chang Arena
entries.addr: 527/99 Jiranakhon Soi 4, Nai Mueang, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: SNOW HOUSE Buriram is a small, newly opened in-town hotel whose selling point is new, spotless rooms at a low price, scoring 8.7 from 20 reviews. It sits in the Jiranakhon area, a walk from city shops and restaurants and about a 10-minute drive (~4 km) to Chang Arena. Real guest reviews agree the rooms look freshly opened, with comfy beds, clean bathrooms, Netflix on the TV and free morning coffee. It's small, though — around 10–17 rooms, no pool, no full restaurant, and review numbers are still low as it's new. Best for budget travellers who want a new, clean room in town and don't need shared facilities.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: With only about 10–17 rooms, it fills fast on big-match or race weekends, so book ahead. The TVs support Netflix for an easy night in. Grab the free morning coffee, then head out to a city restaurant if you want a proper breakfast.
pros: New, spotless rooms that look freshly opened; comfy beds
Netflix + free morning coffee/tea · great value
In town, easy walk to shops and restaurants
Free Wi-Fi + parking, good for drivers
cons: Small hotel: no pool or full restaurant; few reviews so far
About 4 km from Chang Arena — you'll drive to the stadium

entries.name: P Hostel Buriram
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.6 · 70 reviews · 1-min walk to the train station
entries.mrtTag: 📍 By the train station · in town · 1-min walk to platform
tags: 🧼 Cleaner than the price suggests, opened 2023
entries.addr: 188/78 Train Station Front Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: P Hostel Buriram is the cheapest stay in this guide from just ฿320, with a location right by Buriram train station that's hard to beat, scoring 8.6 from 70 reviews. Step off the train, walk about 300 metres or a minute, and you're at the door — ideal for anyone arriving by rail with no need for an onward ride. Opened around 2023, the rooms and bathrooms are still new, and real guest reviews praise the cleanliness, comfy beds, blackout curtains and free water, tea, coffee and snacks downstairs. The catch: reception is daytime–evening only (about 12:00–17:00), Wi-Fi is weak in some rooms, and it's about 5 km from Chang Arena. Best for backpackers and budget travellers arriving by train.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Coming by train is the best value — step off at Buriram station and walk over, no onward fare. Reception is daytime–evening, so message or call ahead if you'll arrive outside those hours. Allow time to reach the stadium via Grab or motorbike taxi.
pros: 1-min walk to the train station — superb for rail travellers
Cleaner than the price suggests; opened 2023, still new
Cheapest in the guide from ฿320 · free water/tea/coffee/snacks
Free Wi-Fi + parking, luggage storage
cons: Reception daytime–evening only; message ahead for late arrivals
Weak Wi-Fi in some rooms · about 5 km from Chang Arena, needs a ride

entries.name: The Park Nangrong Resort
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.5 · 22 reviews · quiet family-run garden resort
entries.badge: 🌿 Quiet garden resort · near Phanom Rung
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nang Rong district · by Nong Ta Mu · ~30 km to Phanom Rung
entries.addr: 445/10 Pradit Phana Rd, Nang Rong, Buriram
entries.storyHtml: The Park Nangrong Resort is a small, quiet family-run garden resort in Nang Rong that works well as a Phanom Rung base at a very low price, scoring 8.5 from 22 reviews. Its 24 rooms sit by Nong Ta Mu lake, about 25–30 km — a half-hour drive — from the Phanom Rung and Mueang Tam temples. Real guest reviews praise the clean rooms, leafy quiet grounds, and an owner and staff so friendly it feels like staying with relatives, plus a Thai breakfast that's filling for the price. Reviewers warn the entrance is narrow and dark and hard to find first time, beds are firm, Wi-Fi isn't strong everywhere, and it's about 50 km from the city and Chang Arena. Best for budget-minded temple visitors.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The entrance is narrow and dark — set GPS accurately and call the owner for directions, especially for night arrivals. Set off early for the ~30-minute drive to Phanom Rung before the heat. Try the resort's Thai breakfast.
pros: Very low price from ฿650 · clean, well-kept rooms
Quiet, leafy, family-run feel
Base for Phanom Rung–Mueang Tam ~30 km
Free parking · pet-friendly · 24-hour front desk
cons: Narrow, dark entrance hard to find first time · Wi-Fi not strong everywhere
Separate district, about 50 km from the city and Chang Arena; best with a car

entries.name: The Sita Princess Hotel
entries.badge: 👨‍👩‍👧 Most reviews · kids' pool with slide
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Jira Rd · city centre · Na Mueang area
entries.addr: 528/48 Jira Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: The Sita Princess Hotel is the most-reviewed property in this guide — 1,731 reviews — a city-centre 3-star with a kids' pool and water slide that families like, scoring 8.4. It sits on Jira Road in the Na Mueang area, central Buriram. Real guest reviews praise the value, rooms cleaner than the price suggests, friendly staff who'll carry your bags, the kids' slide pool, free parking, and a 24-hour front desk that's wheelchair-friendly. You'll need to accept the often-criticised Wi-Fi (weak/dropping), a plain breakfast, and some rooms where upkeep is showing its age. It's about 9–10 km from Chang Arena. Best for budget families and road-trippers.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Wi-Fi gets frequent complaints — bring a mobile-data backup if you need to work online. Take the kids to the slide pool in the shaded afternoon. If walking in, ask to see the room or request a more recently renovated one.
pros: Most reviews in the guide (1,731) · strong data
Kids' pool with water slide, family-friendly
From ฿1,000 in the city centre · rooms cleaner than the price suggests
Free parking · 24-hour front desk, wheelchair-friendly
cons: Wi-Fi weak or dropping · plain breakfast
Some rooms showing their age · about 9–10 km from Chang Arena

entries.name: Thepnakorn Hotel
entries.addr: 139 Jira Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: Thepnakorn Hotel is an old-timer that's been part of Buriram since 1994, with budget rates and big rooms as its selling point, scoring 7.2 from 63 reviews. It's a large 175-room hotel on Jira Road in the city centre. Real guest reviews praise the big, high-ceilinged rooms, friendly and helpful staff, a generous breakfast buffet that's good for the price, and a large pool with a kids' pool, sauna and gym. To be clear, a fair number of reviews criticise the ageing building and inconsistent cleanliness — scores are scattered: Booking 7.2, Trip.com 5.9, TripAdvisor 2.7/5. About 6 km from Chang Arena. Best for budget travellers who value price and space over newness, and who'll ask for a renovated room before accepting it.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Room condition varies, so request a renovated Superior/Luxury room and view it before check-in — check the AC and bathroom; staff are happy to swap. Head down for the generous breakfast reviewers agree on. Allow extra travel time on Chang Arena match days.
pros: Budget from ฿700 · big, high-ceilinged rooms, good value
Large pool with kids' pool, sauna, gym, free parking
Generous breakfast for the price · friendly, helpful staff
Central location, 175 rooms, near markets and restaurants
cons: Ageing building and furnishings, inconsistent cleanliness
Ask for a renovated room and view it first · about 6 km from Chang Arena

faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Buriram hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in around Buriram?
faq.a: It depends on your trip. Around Chang Arena and the Chang Circuit suits football and motorsport visitors, with some hotels walkable to the stadium (Amari, Modena, Sky View, TREX) but away from city dining. The city centre has malls, markets, food and the train station, easy to get around (The Crystal, The Sita Princess, Thepnakorn, SNOW HOUSE, P Hostel). Nang Rong district sits closer to the Phanom Rung and Mueang Tam temples than the city, best for temple visitors (Phanomrungpuri, The Park Nangrong).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Buriram hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: hostels and budget stays start around ฿320–900/night (P Hostel, SNOW HOUSE, The Park Nangrong, Thepnakorn); mid-range hotels and boutiques up to 4-star run about ฿1,000–1,800 (The Sita Princess, Green@Buriram, The Crystal, Modena, TREX, Amari). All are approximate from-rates for standard rooms. During big home matches or MotoGP, stadium-area rates run well above normal.

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay to watch a Buriram United match?
faq.a: To walk to the stadium on match day: Amari Buriram United ฿1,800 is on the Chang Arena grounds, a 2-minute walk, top score 9.7 · Modena by Fraser ฿1,290 is a 5-minute walk, most reviews · on a budget, Sky View Hotel ฿900 is just ~300 m from the stadium. On big-match or MotoGP weekends, stadium-area rooms sell out fast, so book weeks to months ahead.

faq.q: ❓ Using Buriram as a base for Phanom Rung — where to stay?
faq.a: The Phanom Rung and Mueang Tam temples are over in Nang Rong district, about 50 km from Buriram city. If the temples are your main goal, staying in Nang Rong cuts the drive — Phanomrungpuri Hotel ฿850, a Khmer-style boutique, #1 in Nang Rong, or The Park Nangrong Resort ฿650, a quiet garden resort; both are about a 30-minute drive to Phanom Rung. If you'd rather stay in the city too, pick a central hotel with free parking and drive out and back.

faq.q: ❓ Is Buriram easy to get around without a car?
faq.a: Buriram has no metro, so without a car, staying in the city centre or by the train station is easiest — P Hostel is a 1-minute walk from the station, and The Crystal is a walk from the mall. Stays around Chang Arena and in Nang Rong have few restaurants nearby, so a car or Grab helps. Traffic is heavy on big-match days at the stadium, so always allow extra travel time.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Buriram hotels?
faq.a: Prices differ across Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com depending on each site's promotions, so open and compare all three before booking — every review page in this guide includes the comparison links. It can save hundreds of baht a night, especially for stadium-area stays during big matches or races.
